reads: round1_lock.json, probe summary, P1 WP5 constants, P1 grid p_cw and scenes; no F1 value

A1_locked_decomposition.damaged_per_mask_formula: 8 rates x 4 realisations x 2 regimes (ideal, packet) = 64
A1_locked_decomposition.formula: (2 + R_rand) x (1 clean + damaged + 1 p=1) + 1 identity control

A2_pairing.draws: one codeword-erasure draw per (frame, rate, realisation), computed once per frame before the variant loop (p2_f_block_eval.py line 278, seed [20260809, 3, frame, rate, realisation]) and reused by every variant (line 297); the packet regime is derived deterministically from the same draw
A2_pairing.same_count: N_cw = 5256 for every variant, because every variant sends K_F = 23 blocks
A2_pairing.what_pairing_does_not_mean: codeword k carries the k-th chunk of each variant's own message, so the same draw erases different BEV regions under different selections; the channel realisation is paired, the spatial loss is not
A2_pairing.random_layer: random masks are drawn per (frame, repeat) with seed [20260809, 2, frame, repeat] (line 274), independently of the codeword draws; every random mask sees the same codeword draws

A3_cache.computed: P1 WP34 products and grid eff_L

A3_cache.item: pre-wire features: pillar encoder, scatter, backbone blocks, AutoEncoder encoders, branch-2 block output (ego and collaborator)
A3_cache.computed: currently recomputed in every masked forward
A3_cache.reused_by: identical across all conditions of a frame
A3_cache.status: NOT cached; caching would cut time per condition, not the forward count, and needs an identity check against the full path before use

A4_withdrawn: running the loss sweep on only 4 of 20 random masks and the clean condition on the other 16 is withdrawn: it raises the precision of the random baseline under a clean channel only and does not replace repetitions under a damaged channel

B1_stage2.formula: masked forwards per frame = (2 + n2) x 66 + 1
B1_stage2.rule: n2 = the smallest n in [4, 8, 12, 16, 20] with SD_mask / sqrt(n) <= 0.1 x HW_scene; if none, n2 = 20

rule_terms.SD_mask: standard deviation (ddof = 1) across the stage-1 random masks of the scene-equal F1 of random ranking, averaged over the seven locked cells, all stage-1 frames
rule_terms.HW_scene: half-width of the scene-level bootstrap 95 % interval (10,000 resamples) of the scene-equal F1 of random ranking averaged over the stage-1 masks, same cells and frames
rule_terms.why: a Monte Carlo SE at most 0.1 of the scene half-width widens the combined half-width by at most 0.5 %; the rule uses the random baseline only and cannot depend on whether confidence ranking wins

estimate_correction.previous_reason: omitted per-condition CPU work (mask construction and F1 scoring) that the probe residual shows

bias: upper: probe means, including CUDA warm-up and a GPU shared with a desktop session -> pushes UP
lower: component medians combined; not the median of a sum, can understate
one-time dataset build and model load are not included
stage 1 reuses frames and seeds of the probe, so its confidence, norm, random 0 and random 1 values must reproduce the probe CSV bit for bit -- a free determinism check, run programmatically
